WITH
donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS donation_count
    FROM donations

multi_donor_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM donations
    WHERE "Donor" IN (
        SELECT "Donor"
        FROM donor_counts
        WHERE donation_count > 1

),
total_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount

)

    ROUND((multi_donor_donations.total_amount::FLOAT / NULLIF(total_donations.total_amount, 0)) * 100, 2) AS percentage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS number_of_multi_donor_contributors
FROM multi_donor_donations, total_donations;
